name: kren-translate
displayName: KREN: LLM-based Multilingual Dictionary, Translate & Rewrite
description: Selection-first dictionaries, offline English grammar checking, translation, nuance explanation, multilingual rewriting, and read aloud inside VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Dictionaries, grammar checking, translation, explanation, rewriting, and Local Windows speech remain available. Edge Online speech is disabled because it launches a configured Python executable.

virtualWorkspaces.description: KREN is designed for a local VS Code Desktop extension host.

languageModelTools.name: kren_lookupEnglishDictionary
languageModelTools.userDescription: Look up an English word or short expression with Merriam-Webster.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Look up an English word or short multi-word expression in Merriam-Webster Collegiate. For a multi-word expression only, Google Cloud Translation is used when Merriam-Webster returns no entry. Use this for authoritative English dictionary definitions, not general translation.

text.description: The exact English word or short expression to look up. No surrounding document context.

languageModelTools.name: kren_lookupKoreanDictionary
languageModelTools.userDescription: Look up a Korean word with the Korean Basic Dictionary.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Look up one Korean headword in the Korean Basic Dictionary and return its English dictionary entry. Use only for Korean single-word dictionary lookup.

text.description: The exact Korean word to look up.

languageModelTools.name: kren_lookupMedicalDictionary
languageModelTools.userDescription: Look up an English medical term with Merriam-Webster Medical Dictionary.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Look up one English medical term in Merriam-Webster Medical Dictionary. Use for dictionary definitions and terminology, not diagnosis or medical advice.

text.description: The exact English medical term to look up.

languageModelTools.name: kren_searchSynonyms
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find synonyms and related word groups with Merriam-Webster Collegiate Thesaurus.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search Merriam-Webster Collegiate Thesaurus for the explicit English word or short expression. Returns synonyms by sense plus available near synonyms, related words, phrases, antonyms, and near antonyms.

text.description: The exact English word or short expression whose synonyms should be searched.

languageModelTools.name: kren_translateText
languageModelTools.userDescription: Translate explicitly supplied text with the configured KREN provider.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Translate only the explicit text argument with KREN's configured Google Cloud Translation or Gemini provider. The default auto-en-ko target sends English to Korean and Korean to English; an explicit target language overrides it. Do not add editor, file, workspace, or chat context to the text argument.

text.description: Only the exact text the user wants translated.

targetLanguage.description: Optional ISO/BCP-47 output language code or auto-en-ko; otherwise the KREN setting is used.

languageModelTools.name: kren_explainText
languageModelTools.userDescription: Explain the meaning, nuance, register, or connotation of explicitly supplied text.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use KREN's configured Gemini, OpenAI API, or Anthropic Claude API provider to explain meaning, nuance, register, connotation, ambiguity, and technical usage for only the explicit text argument. Do not add editor, file, workspace, or chat context.

text.description: Only the exact text whose meaning or nuance should be explained.

outputLanguage.description: Optional ISO/BCP-47 explanation language code, or bilingual for English and Korean.

enumDescriptions: Use gemini.
Use openai.

Use Groq with its key in Credentials. Free limits apply.
Use Cloudflare Workers AI with the existing account ID and API token. Shares its daily neurons allowance.
Use Handy when installed, otherwise configured Cloudflare, otherwise Groq, otherwise Gemini.
Use the reader's existing local Handy installation.
Record in memory and send one WAV clip at Stop to Groq Whisper large v3 turbo.

kren.tutor.speechProvider.description: Speech-to-text provider for AI English Tutor practice answers and Standard conversation. Handy listens locally and types into the focused answer box. The Gemini route records into memory, sends one WAV clip to Google when you stop, and writes the returned text into the answer box. The Cloudflare route sends that in-memory clip to Cloudflare Workers AI Whisper instead. KREN writes no dictation audio file. The Groq route sends the same in-memory WAV clip to Groq at Stop.

kren.tutor.conversation.hintPrefetch.description: Prepares each hint while you think, so it opens instantly. Uses one extra request per turn.

enumDescriptions: Photographs of real people and places.

kren.tutor.conversation.pressToTalk.description: Press the microphone once to start a Live turn and again to finish it, from the next conversation.

enumDescriptions: Use a lower local gate and shorter Standard quiet period for speech close to the microphone in a quiet room.
Keep KREN's previous local gate and Standard quiet period.
Use a stricter local gate and longer Standard quiet period when other voices are nearby.
kren.tutor.conversation.microphoneSensit.description: Choose how readily KREN's local gate treats sound as speech and how long Standard waits after your speech or its transcription before sending. Quiet room uses a lower threshold and Noisy room resists nearby speech. Pause before reply independently decides the hands-free Live turn end. Gemini's automatic activity detection is disabled in Live, and Press to talk replaces the wait with explicit presses while KREN's local gate still filters audio. This cannot make the provider answer faster after KREN ends the turn.

kren.tutor.conversation.speechDetection.description: Who decides when you start speaking in hands-free Live, from the next conversation. Press to talk uses KREN detection.

kren.tutor.conversation.pauseBeforeReply.description: How long you can pause before KREN treats your turn as finished, in hands-free Live, from the next conversation.

kren.tutor.conversation.microphoneCloseW.description: Choose how long KREN waits for Windows to hand the microphone back before ending the helper. A longer wait means the Windows microphone indicator can stay lit for a few seconds after you press stop.

enumDescriptions: Detect the language. Harper checks English and is skipped on anything else.
Check American English spelling and grammar.
Check British English spelling and grammar.
Check Australian English spelling and grammar.
Check Canadian English spelling and grammar.
Check Indian English spelling and grammar.
kren.grammar.dialect.description: Input language for Grammar Check. Auto-detect runs the offline Harper checker on English and skips it on anything else, where every word would be reported as a misspelling; Smart Grammar Check still reads the passage. Naming a dialect forces Harper to run and sets its regional spelling conventions. Selected text never leaves this computer when Harper runs.

kren.grammar.smart.description: Add a language-model pass beside local Harper when you run Grammar Check, catching mistakes a rule cannot see. On by default. It uses the User Dictionary provider, model, and thinking or effort setting. KREN asks for confirmation before the first request to any provider. Turn it off to keep Grammar Check entirely local. It never applies to automatic paragraph checking, which stays local either way.

kren.grammar.autoCheck.description: After typing pauses, check only the current paragraph with local Harper. Off by default; no text is sent over the network.

kren.grammar.autoCheckDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before optional automatic current-paragraph grammar checking.

kren.readAloud.edgeVoice.description: Editable Microsoft Edge online voice ID. The KREN panel visibly offers Christopher Natural and Ava Natural presets.

kren.readAloud.edgeRatePercent.description: Microsoft Edge online voice speed adjustment. Zero percent is the natural speed.

kren.updates.dailyCheck.description: Silently check system dependencies once a day, including an anonymous PyPI lookup for the latest public edge-tts version. No text, key, or identifier is sent. Turn this off to check only from the KREN menu.

kren.readAloud.edgePythonCommand.description: Python interpreter containing the optional edge-tts package. Install it with: python -m pip install edge-tts

kren.dictionary.multiWordTranslationFall.description: Use Google Cloud Translation when Merriam-Webster has no entry for a multi-word English expression.

kren.pronunciation.windowsNativePlayback.description: On a local Windows extension host, download validated Merriam-Webster pronunciation audio to a bounded temporary file and play it through a hidden native PowerShell/WPF process. No application window opens. Failures fall back to the KREN webview player.

enumDescriptions: Follow the current VS Code theme.
Always use the light panel palette.
Always use the dark panel palette.
kren.display.panelTheme.description: KREN panel theme. The header theme switch remembers Light or Dark; choose Follow VS Code here to follow the editor again.

kren.display.mode.description: Where an immediate result is displayed. Rewrite Text and Grammar Check always open the KREN panel and ignore this setting, because a rewrite carries variants and a grammar result carries per-issue controls, and neither fits a hover card.

enumDescriptions: General-purpose English without a specialized domain style.
Clear professional business prose focused on actions and decisions.
Disciplined academic prose with appropriate qualification and terminology.
Precise scientific prose that preserves units and evidentiary qualifications.
Precise technical prose that preserves necessary specialist terminology.
Precise regulatory prose that preserves defined terms and obligations.
Precise medical prose that preserves clinical qualifications and terminology.
Precise legal prose that preserves defined terms, qualifications, and legal effect.
kren.translation.domain.description: Subject area a translation writes for. Guides terminology and conventions without sending document or workspace context. Ignored by Google Cloud Translation, whose API accepts no such parameter.

kren.translation.maxCharacters.description: Maximum number of selected characters sent to a provider.

kren.request.timeoutMs.description: How long KREN waits for a provider. Cloudflare pictures wait at least 60 seconds; Google Cloud speech ignores this.

kren.groq.customModels.description: KREN-managed JSON list of groq model identifiers added with the Add control.

kren.cloudflare.customModels.description: KREN-managed JSON list of cloudflare model identifiers added with the Add control.
